ops.title: Bound fetch connectivity checks away from unrelated metadata ledgers
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccx_related_topk_ship. Actual host has repeated rev-list --exclude-promisor-objects --not --exclude-hidden=fetch --all children and tens of thousands of metadata refs. Git2.56 source proves fetch.hideRefs only changes connectivity negative roots, while one nonpromisor fetched tip forces fallback and all promisor OIDs are still enumerated. Next: isolated stock-Git remote CI reproduces actual all-promisor/mixed tips, object-read scaling and metadata fetch/retention semantics; obtain independent review before any local config. Evidence: fundamental-efficiency/git-connectivity/connected.c, fetch.c, revision.c, fetch-pack.c; parent bounded packedrefs census. No production change or host recovery claim.

ops.text: Pinned stock Git remote CI measures baseline/excluded metadata object reads at32 and4096 refs with raw strace and actual fetch fallback source.
Independent source and CI review preserves missing-object errors, metadata fetch/sync, negotiation and retention; explicitly records residual promisor enumeration.

Only after proof and parent approval apply precise local fetch.hideRefs or implement accepted fundamental alternative, then measure actual affected host fetch; no transfer.hideRefs or session disruption.
